steps.speaker: Wuhuanzi
steps.content: Though I suspected as much... aren't you perhaps... putting too much faith in me? I have mentioned before that medicine isn't omnipotent. If you keep depleting your Qi like this, not even divine intervention could save you...

Wuhuanzi's already subdued demeanor has noticeably darkened further in response to the current circumstances—you're certain you're not imagining it. Her words trail off, almost merging into a sigh, prompting you to jump in before she can proceed.

options: This will be the last time.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I promise. I've gathered all the artifacts Yugu mentioned, so the Wisteria Pavilion should open its gate... I can go in soon and put an end to this fete.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: So...

steps.speaker: Wuhuanzi
steps.content: Is this last treatment to be both your rejuvenation and parting blessing? You seem quite certain that all answers lie within the Wisteria Pavilion.

The young Eastian herbalist lets out a sigh and helps you sit against the wall as usual, though her movements are slightly rougher this time. You fight the urge to rub your throbbing temples as you look up at her clearly disapproving expression.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I can't say for sure how much of Yugu's words holds true. But I know without a doubt that the Wisteria Pavilion is the core of this fete. I've been inside before... and the answer to everything lies right there.

steps.speaker: Wuhuanzi
steps.content: What I want to know is, even if you make it into the Wisteria Pavilion, are you certain you can hold out until you "solve everything"? I could tell from our first meeting that you were already suffering from spiritual and physical exhaustion...

steps.speaker: Wuhuanzi
steps.content: Despite my efforts to support you on this journey, I could scarcely keep you going—and that hardly made any impact in the broader context. Should you venture into that place... how long can you endure? Will you even be able to fight?

Wuhuanzi's words mirror the chill of her hands—sharp as a surgeon's scalpel, cutting with brutal precision. Though her pessimism can be overwhelming, the concerns she raises are impossible to deny. You find yourself at a loss for words.
As you struggle to stir your thoughts—now as thick and congealed as cold porridge—searching for words that might convince Wuhuanzi, she unexpectedly gives a resigned smile.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: ...Wuhuanzi?

steps.speaker: Wuhuanzi
steps.content: Save your strength, my friend. There's no need to try convincing me anymore. No matter how much I object, you won't give up anyway, will you?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You're right... This is the only path left for me to take, after all.

steps.speaker: Wuhuanzi
steps.content: Very well. Your nature has been clear to me from the start—forging ahead despite the insurmountable odds. Interposing at this point would serve as nothing but futile opposition.

Her sudden compliance catches you off guard. As you stare at her in confusion, she produces a handkerchief from her sleeve and carefully unfolds it, revealing a round pill emanating the scent of medicinal herbs.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: This is...?

steps.speaker: Wuhuanzi
steps.content: All this time spent rushing around the streets with you, conducting examinations... it hasn't been in vain. I've gained some more understanding of "Qi"—what it drives, what it sustains, and what it changes...

steps.speaker: Wuhuanzi
steps.content: And I've learned how it cycles and harmonizes with all else. With this insight, I can prevent your Qi from depleting without resorting to taxing exertions as before. All I need to do now is use medicine to protect your internal organs.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You mean... if I take this, I won't have to worry about running out of Qi anymore?

steps.speaker: Wuhuanzi
steps.content: At least for a short period... yes.

You never expected this young herbalist from Eastia could help you to such an extent. Your eyes widen in amazement as you stare at her. Only after Wuhuanzi gives a solemn nod do you carefully reach out, take the pill, and place it in your mouth.

In an instant, the exhaustion from Qi depletion dissipates, and your mind becomes crystal clear once more. Though you don't understand how it works, the medicine you took without hesitation proves remarkably effective.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: This is incredible... It's not my first time experiencing it firsthand, but Eastian medicine never fails to amaze me... No, this must be because of your exceptional skill, Wuhuanzi. You really are a miracle worker...

Even if it's only temporary, finding a solution to this problem fills you with joy. Like discovering a precious treasure, you shower Wuhuanzi with praise. Even your upcoming mission to the Wisteria Pavilion, which you were unsure about before, now seems more promising.
Yet Wuhuanzi shows not even a trace of joy at your praise. She shakes her head ever so slightly as a deeper melancholy clouds her weary eyes.

steps.speaker: Wuhuanzi
steps.content: Miracle worker... If only there were true miracle cures, if only there were miracle herbalists capable of saving all... but regretfully, this medicine only offers temporary relief, a brief respite from your troubles.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: That's more than enough! I can't expect you to solve everything, can I? I'm the one who chose to save the people trapped here, to deal with this dangerous fete... Even if the medicine wears off, it's my responsibility to figure out what to do.

steps.speaker: Wuhuanzi
steps.content: "Solve"... Such a vague word, just like "cure." These are things I truly cannot do.

Her words leave you momentarily puzzled, but the young girl from Eastia seems to have no intention of making herself clear. She simply raises her head to gaze at the magnificent building in the distance, its gate tightly shut. Her expression is a paradox—both steeled for battle and resigned to defeat.

steps.speaker: Wuhuanzi
steps.content: Heal one patient, and another appears. Mend old injuries, only for new ones to form... Patients like you, who need treatment again and again despite our best efforts—that is the norm for us herbalists. We are truly powerless, forever fighting a losing battle.

steps.speaker: Wuhuanzi
steps.content: That's why I tried to warn you—such persistence is futile. Yet, I understand. Even if it means using a cup of water to put out a cartload of burning firewood, like a mantis raising its arms to block a cart, people never learn to turn back until they hit a wall.

Though her Eastian idioms and metaphors elude your understanding, her tightly pressed lips and clenched fists speak volumes—she seems to be fighting something, a battle that exists only within her heart. After a moment of internal struggle, she raises her head again.

steps.speaker: Wuhuanzi
steps.content: My friend... This is all I can do for you now. Once you enter the Wisteria Pavilion, even if I wish to help you further, I'm afraid my abilities will fall short.

steps.speaker: Wuhuanzi
steps.content: And it's not just me... Even you might find yourself powerless once inside. Medicine, artifacts, a kind heart, and even the most earnest determination—all might prove futile in the end. But you're still going in, aren't you?
You have no other choice. Though you sense there's more to her words than meets the eye, you can't stop to question her further—not when you're so close to your goal.

steps.speaker: Wuhuanzi
steps.content: ...I see. Then all I can do is give you my best wishes... May fortune favor you, and may your wishes be fulfilled.

She presses her lips together gently, her gaze fixed on you yet seeming to look through you at something far beyond. Then, shouldering her belongings, she silently accompanies you toward the grand building glowing with lamplight.
